verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents bank feeds, payment-processor sync, or payroll integrations that post activity into the ledger automatically. Customer payment options (iDEAL, credit card, direct debit) are a payment-collection feature, and the REST API, webhooks, MCP and CLI are developer building blocks, so neither earns credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can connect my banking, payments, and payroll systems so their activity flows into the ledger automatically
